description.value: Tsartlip PUMP is a First Nations-owned convenience store and fuel station operated by the Tsartlip First Nation on W̱SÁNEĆ territory in Saanichton, BC. The store carries groceries, beverages, coffee, frozen treats, ice, and souvenirs including Native Northwest apparel, alongside regular, mid-grade, premium, and diesel fuel. Eligible customers can access tax-exempt purchasing on fuel and select in-store items.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://tsartlip.com/pump/ provides a detailed Products & Services listing confirming the store is active, with an address (1518 Stelly's X-Road, Saanichton BC V8M 1S8) and phone (250-652-1110) not present in the OSM tags. Grocery items, ice, public washrooms, and an air service are all explicitly named on the website's service list. No mention of bike parking or water refill was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone or address; both sourced from website (250-652-1110; 1518 Stelly's X-Road, Saanichton BC V8M 1S8).
OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but website address shows Saanichton BC — these are adjacent communities and not a material discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active First Nations-owned convenience store and fuel station with confirmed address, phone, and range of services useful to touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Ice.detail: Ice listed under Grocery products on website

Pump.detail: Air listed under Services on website; gas station air compressors are usable by cyclists for tyre inflation
